description: Make a full copy of one bot flow (any type) by ID: the reply, its media, and all of its buttons, list sections and follow-up replies. The copy has the same keywords and the same ON/OFF state as the original, so two flows now answer the same keywords — change the copy's keyword with update_bot_conversation, or turn it off with set_bot_conversation_active. Each call creates a new copy. Run get_bot_conversations with enabled_only=false to find IDs.

id.description: ID of the bot flow to copy (from get_bot_conversations)

name: duplicate_bot_conversation
